title: Tour of Africa
description: From Atlantic cities to the Great Rift Valley.

stops.title: Lagos
stops.caption: A lagoon city at the heart of contemporary Nigerian music, film and commerce.

stops.title: Accra
stops.caption: Atlantic coast, public squares and the story of Ghanaian independence.

stops.title: Marrakesh
stops.caption: Courtyards, gardens and a medina beneath the Atlas Mountains.

stops.title: Cairo
stops.caption: A Nile metropolis beside one of the world’s best-known ancient landscapes.

stops.title: Addis Ababa
stops.caption: A highland capital and the headquarters city of the African Union.

stops.title: Nairobi
stops.caption: A major East African city on the edge of highland savanna.

stops.title: Cape Town
stops.caption: Table Mountain and the Atlantic frame a city with a layered history.

title: Ancient Wonders
description: Human ambition, written into the landscape.

stops.title: Giza
stops.caption: The pyramid fields connect modern Cairo with the Old Kingdom.

stops.title: Petra
stops.caption: Rock-cut architecture and water engineering in an ancient Nabataean city.

stops.title: The Acropolis
stops.caption: A hilltop ensemble shaped by fifth-century BCE Athens.

stops.title: Rome
stops.caption: An amphitheatre at the centre of a city built across many eras.

stops.title: Agra
stops.caption: Mughal architecture, river gardens and the Taj Mahal.

stops.title: Angkor
stops.caption: A vast Khmer urban and temple landscape, reshaped over centuries.

stops.title: Machu Picchu
stops.caption: Inca stonework and terraces high above the Urubamba Valley.

title: Mega Cities
description: Seven places to feel the scale of urban life.

stops.title: Tokyo
stops.caption: Rail lines and neighbourhoods connect one of the world’s largest urban regions.

stops.title: Delhi
stops.caption: Successive capitals, bazaars and modern districts overlap across a vast metropolis.

stops.title: Shanghai
stops.caption: A port city shaped by the Huangpu River and global exchange.

stops.title: Lagos
stops.caption: Lagoons, bridges and an extraordinary creative economy.

stops.title: São Paulo
stops.caption: Brazil’s largest city is a continent of neighbourhoods and migrations.

stops.title: Mexico City
stops.caption: A high-altitude metropolis built across Indigenous and colonial layers.

stops.title: New York
stops.caption: Five boroughs, a working harbour and a global meeting point.
